title: X-Tun X-Koh (Sistema Actun Koh line plot) - Down Loop part
credits: X-Tun X-Koh: line plot of Sistema Actun Koh (Puerto Aventuras), Up Loop 4,068 ft and Down Loop 2,108 ft, grid in feet from station 0 at Cenote Actun Koh; author and date not on the map. Filed as 'X-tun and X-koh, Ejo. Pino Suarez' from wetworx.nl/Cavemaps (accessed May 2015).
placementWhy: Moderate (about 10-20 m; it inherits the placement of the Mafia Maps 1998 plan, maps/actun-koh-mafia.json): see maps/x-koh.json for why this line plot is placed in two parts. Free similarity fit on seven junctions read off the placed Mafia plan's lines (Section Six, the Down Loop, Grin, Hook/Rebel, Teen/Gossip), residuals 0.2-1.8 m; 0.603 m/px, 5.7 degrees. Checks: station 0 lands 14 m from the database's Actun Koh (Google Maps source, on which the Mafia and Yuc 96 maps put their Actun Koh pool), and the X south of the Down Loop (Overpass Cenote on the Mafia plan) lands on the north edge of the dark pond visible on the Mapbox/Maxar imagery, 17 m from the centre of OSM's 'Cenote' pond (way 405950395).
